duty.cafe: go to the Coffee Cup and make coffee for tips.
duty.stand: go to Fig Jr.’s stand and pour lemonade for tips.

wage: wage so far {coins}; days to payday: {days}.
done: the week’s work is done: a full wage. Extra work still earns XP.

nudge.condo: Spinner asks you in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.store: Pip asks you in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.post: Stamp asks you in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.cafe: Bean asks you in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.
nudge.stand: Fig Jr. asks you in this week: two empty weeks in a row and the job is gone.

fired.condo: Spinner has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.store: Pip has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.post: Stamp let you go after empty weeks; ask again and you start at the first rank.
fired.cafe: Bean has let you go; ask again and you start from the first cup.
fired.stand: Fig Jr. has let you go; reapply and you start again at entry level.

cafeDone: tips add up on the tray as you pour; paid when you leave work.
standDone: tips add up on the tray glass by glass; paid when you leave work.
payslip: go home and open your payslip in your homestead mailbox.

call.sweep: Spinner calls: litter on the arcade floor, open for the rest of the day.
call.fix: Spinner calls: a cabinet has gone dark, open for the rest of the day.
call.restock: Pip calls: crates wait for the empty shelves, open for the rest of the day.
call.serve: Pip calls: customers need serving at the till, open for the rest of the day.
call.deliver: Pip calls: a parcel at the store to deliver, open for the rest of the day.

answered: every call today is answered; nothing more is wanted until tomorrow.
tipsAll: today’s tips are all earned; shifts still earn work XP.
